sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card (May 2026 update)
sources.evidence: Names Gemini 3 Pro as a Gemini-series reasoning model, explicitly describes its architecture as a sparse MoE Transformer, and lists hosted products/APIs as distribution channels. It gives no total or per-token active parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro preview — Gemini API
sources.evidence: Exact model code gemini-3-pro-preview; input limit 1,048,576, output limit 65,536; text/image/video/audio/PDF inputs and text output; thinking and function calling supported. Links the Gemini 3 Pro model card. Explicitly says the endpoint was shut down March 9, 2026; page updated August 18, 2026.

sources.title: Start building with Gemini 3
sources.evidence: November 18, 2025 announcement says Gemini 3 Pro is available in preview through the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and Vertex AI, and describes reasoning, coding and multimodal understanding.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.evidence: The exact gemini-3-pro-preview row records release November 18, 2025 and shutdown March 9, 2026, with gemini-3.1-pro-preview as replacement. The image-preview variant is a separate row with a different release date.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Model Card
sources.evidence: Later February 2026 card says Gemini 3.1 Pro is based on Gemini 3 Pro and refers to the original card for architecture. Its exact Gemini 3 Pro comparison column reports benchmark scores, not model parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card
sources.evidence: Checked this later October 2026 card for retrospective parameter disclosure. It provides no numerical total or active parameter count for Gemini 3 Pro; its specifications describe Gemini 4 Argon and are not transferred to this model.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Provides proprietary service terms for Gemini API and AI Studio. Read together with the original model card distribution section, this supports a proprietary classification rather than a released-weight license. The currently displayed terms are effective March 23, 2026; no historical term version is asserted.

sources.title: Empty shelves or lost keys? Recall is the bottleneck for parametric factuality
sources.evidence: August 2026 first-party behavioral research explicitly includes Gemini-3-Pro. It studies encoded knowledge and recall, without disclosing its total or active parameter count or replacing the model-card architecture description.

sources.title: Models.dev Gemini 3 Pro Preview record
sources.evidence: Followed the baseline catalog link. It supplies the gemini-pro grouping and repeats the preview identity and API limits; technical claims were independently checked against Google sources.

name.note: Official API title and exact model code confirm this preview identity.

parameters_b.note: No numerical total count appears in the reviewed original/update card, later comparison cards, or first-party research. Preserve null rather than infer a size.

active_parameters_b.note: Sparse routing is documented, but no numerical per-token active count is disclosed in the reviewed sources. Do not infer it from total capacity or other variants.

architecture.note: The exact endpoint links to the Gemini 3 Pro card, which explicitly specifies a sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer with native multimodal inputs.

context_window.note: Exact endpoint input-token limit. This is a historical documented specification, not proof of current endpoint operation; output has a separate 65,536-token limit.

modalities.note: The exact API page lists all five input types and text output; image/audio generation are unsupported.

reasoning.note: Thinking support is explicitly listed for this preview endpoint.

description.value: Google's Gemini 3 Pro preview reasoning model for coding and multimodal understanding; its Gemini API endpoint was shut down on March 9, 2026.

patch.notes: Sparse MoE Transformer; total and active parameter counts are undisclosed in the reviewed first-party sources. Context and capabilities describe the retired gemini-3-pro-preview endpoint, shut down March 9, 2026. Distinct from Gemini 3 Pro Image and Gemini 3.1 Pro.

research_notes.exact_identity: The Google API page explicitly links this preview endpoint to the Gemini 3 Pro model card. Original preview release and retirement are independently listed in the official lifecycle table.
research_notes.parameter_and_architecture_checks: Reviewed the May 2026 Gemini 3 Pro card, the February 2026 Gemini 3.1 Pro card with its exact Gemini 3 Pro comparison column, the October 2026 Gemini 4 Argon card, and August 2026 Google Research work. Searched first-party domains for exact-model total/active parameters, training, interpretability, mechanistic research and sparse autoencoders; no additional production parameter count was found. Architecture is explicitly disclosed in the original model card.
research_notes.access_limitations: The old Vertex AI /models/gemini/3-pro URL redirects to a general Google-models page. The Gemini API exact-model page remains accessible and supplies the historical specifications. No live inference request was made.

summary: Audited all 14 fields. Added explicit MoE architecture and proprietary classification, replaced promotional description with supported capabilities and endpoint retirement, and upgraded provenance to first-party sources. Confirmed November 18, 2025 release, 1,048,576 input limit, modalities, thinking and function calling. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; no image-variant or successor specifications were transferred.
